guide.field_arcana.page.1:
§lField Primer§r

The world is full of invisible fields.

A field arcanist never throws a fireball. They bend the fields and let physics do the rest.

Hold a Resonance Lens and the fields become visible.
guide.field_arcana.page.2:
§lThe four fields§r

§5Gravis§r: pulls everything
§3Fulgur§r: like charges repel
§6Nexus§r: space turns viscous
§2Mutatio§r: matter changes

A Field Core chooses which field you touch.
guide.field_arcana.page.3:
§lResonance Lens§r

While held, field lines appear: they leave + charges and sink into − charges.

Use it to pick the field to observe. φ is the potential, |E| the field strength.
guide.field_arcana.page.4:
§lInterference Staff§r

Hold a Field Core in the other hand and use. Sneak+use switches mode.

Emit: a source
Imbue: charge a creature
Lens: field ×3
Shield: field ×0
guide.field_arcana.page.5:
§lResonance§r

The staff slowly refills from the ambient fields around you.

Thunderstorms, the Nether and the deep earth refill it fast. Inside a shield it does not refill at all.
guide.field_arcana.page.6:
§l§5Gravis§r

Every body carries Gravis charge equal to its mass, so everything falls alike.

Emit + for a gravity well: items and arrows are drawn in. A negative source pushes away.
guide.field_arcana.page.7:
§l§3Fulgur§r

Neutral matter feels nothing. Only charged bodies move.

Like charges repel, unlike attract. Creepers are born charged.
guide.field_arcana.page.8:
§lDielectric breakdown§r

When a strong Fulgur field passes through a charged creature, a spark jumps and the charge drains away.

Charge a foe negative, then let a + source pull it in.
guide.field_arcana.page.9:
§l§6Nexus§r

Inside a Nexus field space itself grows viscous and every motion slows.

Break a fall, stop an arrow, hold a pursuer.
guide.field_arcana.page.10:
§l§2Mutatio§r and transmutation

Mutatio only opens matter. The other fields decide what it becomes.

Sand + Fulgur → glass
Cobble + Gravis → deepslate
Mud + Nexus → clay
guide.field_arcana.page.11:
§lField Emitter§r
A source whose charge follows its redstone signal. Empty hand flips polarity.

§lField Sensor§r
Turns a field into a redstone signal.

Together: wireless redstone.
guide.field_arcana.page.12:
§lLast words§r

Spells, machines, even the weather all interfere on the same fields.

Seek the combinations no one designed. That is the craft.

guide.field_arcana.page.13:
§lField Resonator§r

An oscillating source. Redstone sets its amplitude.
Empty hand: period.
Sneak: phase +90°.

Its wave travels at 0.5 blocks/tick, so wavelength = 0.5 × period.
guide.field_arcana.page.14:
§lInterference§r

Resonators with the same period interfere. In phase they reinforce on the mid-plane; out of phase they cancel there.

A Field Sensor in amplitude mode reads the pattern. Amethyst sings at the antinodes.
guide.field_arcana.page.15:
§lField Shaper§r

A lasting lens or shield around the block. Redstone sets the radius.
Empty hand: mode (×0, ×0.5, ×2, ×3).
Core: only that field.
Sneak: every field.
guide.field_arcana.page.16:
§lMagnets§r

Neutral metal is polarised by Fulgur and drifts into the strongest field, whatever its sign.

Power a Fulgur emitter and dropped ingots gather at its faces. Minecarts feel it too.
